name: Pembrolizumab (MSI-H / dMMR mCRPC, tissue-agnostic)

institution.provenance: ONCOTREE draft protocol authored from standard-of-care oncology knowledge (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Single-agent PD-1 blockade in prostate cancer is used only under the tissue-agnostic MSI-H / dMMR (or high tumor mutational burden) indication after progression on standard therapy; it is not effective in microsatellite-stable disease. Continue ADT to maintain castrate testosterone. General reference: standard guidelines and oncology texts.

supportiveCare: Continue ADT to keep testosterone below 50 ng/dL through immunotherapy.
Pembrolizumab is given until progression, unacceptable toxicity, or the labeled maximum duration; each 21-day cycle repeats the same single dose.
Counsel on immune-related adverse events and provide a patient wallet card.
monitoring: immune-related toxicity screen before cycles (TSH / free T4, LFTs, glucose, cortisol as indicated)
symptom review for immune colitis, pneumonitis, hepatitis, dermatitis, and endocrinopathies
PSA and radiographic response (watch for pseudoprogression on immunotherapy)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold pembrolizumab and treat with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; obtain clinical review before rechallenge and discontinue permanently for severe or recurrent grade 3-4 events. Physician decides.

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.notes: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV on day 1 of a 21-day cycle (an equivalent alternative schedule is 400 mg IV every 6 weeks). Used here under the tissue-agnostic MSI-H / dMMR indication for mCRPC; continue ADT. Dose reflects standard PD-1 checkpoint-inhibitor practice (general reference). No ISMP tall-man form.
